profile.about: Passionate web developer, graduated with a Master's in Networks & Software Engineering from UCLouvain (2026). With hands-on experience at Pluriell, I'm skilled in fullstack development and Agile workflows. Curious, rigorous, and always looking to grow.

bullets: Development and maintenance of full-stack web applications.
Design and integration of new features.
Participation in Agile/Scrum sprints and code reviews.
Development of a web application from scratch.
Onboarding onto the company's professional workflow and tools.
Development of a web interface for visualizing sensor data.
Academic mentoring of first-year Bachelor's students.
Welcoming visitors during open days and liaising with the administration.
Development of a mobile app for visually impaired people, as part of a team under time pressure.

items.degree: Thesis – Design and Implementation of a Modular Web Platform for Whole-Slide Image Analysis Integrating the DICOM Standard
bullets: Design of a modular, collaborative web platform for high-resolution histological image analysis (whole-slide imaging), integrating the DICOM standard.
